result:
I stopped round 457 and need B's ruling on a new walker bug, A-R457-REVIEW-M1 (Medium). The round can't close as PASS until B rules.

**The bug.** I couldn't fix it myself because the fix belongs in `style-scan.ts`, which is sha-pinned, and the task lists "a new silent-drop form of the walker" as a stop trigger. The code-reviewer found it and I reproduced it.
- The walker treats `'~/lib/u/'` and `'~/lib/u/index'` as the file `lib/u.ts` whenever a folder `lib/u/` with an `index.ts` sits next to it.
- TypeScript loads `u/index.ts` for those imports instead. I confirmed this with a small `tsc` check; that Vite behaves the same way is an inference, not measured.
- So files imported through that folder show as unmounted, and LT9 stays green.
- The trailing-slash handling came with this round's patch; the `/index` handling was already on the base commit (`db95f40`).
- Nothing in the app triggers it today: there is one such pair (`lib/utils.ts` next to `lib/utils/index.ts`) and no importer uses either form. LT7's results are unaffected.
- The reviewer's simpler fix, a rule banning that file/folder pairing, would fail on today's tree because of `lib/utils`. B has to choose between that rule with an allow-list entry and changing how the walker resolves folders.
- Two Low variants of the same kind of bug also reproduce:
  - an `export interface P {}` written before an `export { Row } from` in a file that imports a barrel;
  - a second import of the same barrel placed inside a `'audio/*' … '*/'` pair, with a comment in its braces.

**What I ran:**
- **Claims:** the before and after outputs match B's saved files, with empty error output.
- **Patch:** the file hashes matched before applying (3) and after (4), and still match after all runs.
- **Typecheck:** passes.
- **Lint:** 205 warnings, the same as B's pre-check.
- **Biome:** clean on the 4 test files.
- **Covering tests:** all 27 pass across the 4 files (LT1–LT9, GS1–GS4, GT1–GT5b, TS1–TS6).
- **Mutants:** results identical to B's list; the baseline and control stay green and M1–M32 fail as expected.
- **Doc 299:** rewritten as the task requires. I didn't edit its "only adds matches" sentence, which the bug disproves; B needs to rule on it.
- **Scope:** only the 6 granted paths are changed.
- **Code-reviewer:** ran (score 8/10). Besides the Medium, it raised 5 Lows; they and its architecture note (move the walker into its own `helpers/mount-graph.ts`) are passed to B unchanged.

I ran no browser check and marked no C rows; the full suite, build and verify are left to the root gate. I also didn't re-read three primitives (`TESTING_QUALITY_GATES.md`, `BUG_HUNTING_TESTS.md`, `AGENT_DISCOVERABLE_CODE.md`), since no test code was written by hand. Nothing was committed or reverted.

For C, the report lists a short run: source scope, claims, the purchase-protection half of C7, and a replay of my probe on a fresh clone with the full recipe. Then FAIL "STOPPED — routed to B".

The report is in `tmp/studio-real-loop/a-round-457.md`, with the probe, its output and all logs in `tmp/studio-real-loop/a-round-457/`.
